notes.title: Update v1.31.51 - The Bunker
notes.content:
Please welcome new tools of destruction! Rank 15 now gives you an opportunity to call an artillery strike at your location. But first you have to find the secret bunker...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39230446/2b0f55a015cce1ad3ca4701513c4cc38e9d63acd.jpg[/img]

ADDED: New ground explosion effect for grenade.
ADDED: New ground explosion effect for rocket.
ADDED: New ground explosion effect for missile.
ADDED: New ground explosion effect for tank projectile.
ADDED: The artillery strike in Time Attack.
ADDED: New player voice alternative for trying to open locked doors.

FIXED: Missing floor tile near the harbor.

+Some performance improvements.
